items.exampleEn: She spent her life fighting injustice in the workplace.
items.exampleZh: 她一生都在對抗職場上的不公平。

items.exampleEn: Getting a new passport can be a slow, bureaucratic process.
items.exampleZh: 辦新護照可能是個緩慢又官僚的過程。

items.exampleEn: The singer asked reporters to stop harassing her family.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手要求記者不要再騷擾她的家人。

items.exampleEn: Forensic experts studied the tiny marks left on the glass.
items.exampleZh: 鑑識專家研究了玻璃上留下的細小痕跡。

items.exampleEn: This is the country's premier art school.
items.exampleZh: 這是該國首屈一指的藝術學校。

items.exampleEn: The charity builds schools in impoverished villages.
items.exampleZh: 這個慈善團體在貧困的村莊興建學校。

items.exampleEn: In the seventeenth century, the scientist Galileo faced persecution for his ideas.
items.exampleZh: 十七世紀時，科學家 Galileo 因為自己的想法而遭受迫害。

items.exampleEn: The officer refused to accept a bribe from the driver.
items.exampleZh: 那名員警拒絕收下駕駛給的賄賂。

items.sentenceEn: The new online system makes the process less bureaucratic.
items.sentenceZh: 新的線上系統讓手續不再那麼官僚繁瑣。

items.audioEn: Our city hosts the region's premier book fair every autumn.
items.audioZh: 我們的城市每年秋天都會舉辦這個地區最頂尖的書展。
items.questionZh: 這座城市每年秋天舉辦什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The reporter was harassed by angry fans online.
items.sentenceZh: 那位記者在網路上被憤怒的粉絲騷擾。

items.sentenceEn: The children felt a sense of injustice when only one team got prizes.
items.sentenceZh: 只有一隊拿到獎品時，孩子們覺得很不公平。

items.stemEn: The lab uses ____ tests to find out who was at the scene.
items.stemZh: 實驗室用鑑識檢驗來查出誰曾在現場。

items.stemEn: The company tried to ____ the inspector, but he reported it to the police.
items.stemZh: 那家公司試圖賄賂檢查員，但他向警方舉報了。

items.passageEn: Lena studies law at the country's premier university. On weekends, she volunteers at a free legal help center in an impoverished part of the city. Many visitors come with tedious, bureaucratic problems, such as forms that were rejected three times in a row. Others have more serious stories. One man said his landlord kept harassing him to leave his apartment. Lena listened carefully and helped him fill in a complaint form. She also reads history books about persecution, because she believes that small injustices, if ignored, can grow into large ones.
items.passageZh: Lena 在國內頂尖的大學讀法律。週末時，她在城裡一個貧困地區的免費法律諮詢中心當志工。許多來訪者帶著繁瑣又官僚的問題，例如表格連續被退件了三次。也有人的處境更嚴重。一名男子說，房東一直騷擾他，逼他搬出公寓。Lena 仔細聽他說，並幫他填寫申訴表。她也會讀關於迫害的歷史書，因為她相信，小小的不公平如果被忽視，可能會演變成很大的不公。

questions.questionZh: Lena 幫那名男子做了什麼？
options: 立刻搬出公寓、另外找一間新的住處
仔細聆聽並幫他填申訴表

questions.questionZh: Lena 為什麼讀關於迫害的歷史書？
options: 學校的歷史課規定一定要讀這些書
她認為小的不公平可能變大
她想寫一本關於城市歷史的小說
法律中心的同事推薦她看這些書

items.promptZh: 申請補助的過程太官僚了，我等了半年。
referenceEn: The process of applying for the grant was too bureaucratic; I waited six months.
Applying for the grant was so bureaucratic that I waited half a year.
rubricZh: bureaucratic 是形容詞，表示「官僚的、手續繁瑣的」（例如 a bureaucratic process 等）
「申請補助」可寫，例如 applying for the grant、the grant application 等
「等了半年」可寫，例如 waited six months、waited half a year 等

items.promptZh: 這部電影講述一位記者揭發社會不公的故事。
referenceEn: The film tells the story of a reporter who exposes social injustice.
This movie is about a journalist who reveals injustice in society.
rubricZh: 「社會不公」用 injustice，例如 social injustice、injustice in society 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：mcq 干擾項 violet（顏色，低階字）代入 ___ tests 與「鑑識」題意明顯無關，一眼可排除（§11-26）；ghostly 亦相近。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: violet、ghostly 換成同為形容詞的已教字 impoverished、juvenile（後者與司法情境同類），只看英文時代入都不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：人名 Lena 在中譯與題目音譯為「莉娜」，與其他課保留英文名的體例不一致。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 中文欄保留英文名 Lena，題目同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：Lena 在法律諮詢中心教當事人「把每次來訪和電話都記下來當證據」，形同具體的法律實務建議；u20 法律主題要求只寫中性事實，建議改為中性描述（如 Lena listened and helped him fill in a form）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改成中性描述 Lena listened carefully and helped him fill in a complaint form.，第 1 小題正解同步改

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：exampleEn 只說 the glass，中譯「玻璃杯」多加了「杯」，可譯「玻璃上」。
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 9：干擾項 flatter 語意怪但不算完全不通
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 13：persecution 卡屬難民或政治迫害情境
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示改成歷史事實句 In the seventeenth century, the scientist Galileo faced persecution for his ideas.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：bureaucratic 是形容詞，表示「官僚的、手續繁瑣的」（例如 a bureaucratic process 等）／「申請補助」可寫，例如 applying for the grant、the grant application 等／「等了半年」可寫，例如 waited six months、waited half a year 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（injustice）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u20-l02-q17；目標字沿用 injustice
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這部電影講述一位記者揭發社會不公的故事。」、hintWords ["injustice"]、referenceEn ["The film tells the story of a reporter who exposes social injustice.","This movie is about a journalist who reveals injustice in society."]、rubricZh ["「社會不公」用 injustice，例如 social injustice、injustice in society 等","「揭發」可寫，例如 exposes、reveals、uncovers 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 injustice 造一個句子，說說一件你覺得不公平的事。」、referenceEn ["It felt like an injustice when my brother got a bigger piece of cake.","I think it is an injustice that some children are not able to go to school."]）
